text: …さあ　あ　でも　そういえば　そとに　ある　そだてやさんで　タマゴが　みつかったって　きいた　ことが　あるわよ

structure.jp: あ　でも　そういえば
structure.en: oh, but come to think of it

structure.jp: そとに　ある　そだてやさんで
structure.en: at the Day Care that's outside

structure.jp: タマゴが　みつかったって
きいた　ことが　あるわよ

patterns.name: 〜たことがある
patterns.span: きいた　ことが　ある
patterns.explanation: A past verb plus ことが ある says you have had that experience at some time. きいた ことが ある = 'I have heard (it) before'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual spoken form of と that wraps up what was said or heard, like 'that'. みつかったって = 'that one was found'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: そとに　ある　そだてやさん
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. そとに ある そだてやさん = 'the Day Care that is outside'.
